in_sanskrit.name: प्राणिधा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who gives life or nourishes life

in_marathi.name: Pranitha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Gift of God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pranitha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Pranamita is the Sanskrit root of the name Pranitha. Prana means breath, life, or energy in Sanskrit. The suffix ‘itha’ means ‘gift’ or ‘receiver’. Pranitha is a name that signifies the one who is the receiver of God’s prana (life or breath).

in_bengali.name: Pranitha
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Gift of God
in_bengali.long_meaning: Pranitha একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Pranamita is the Sanskrit root of the name Pranitha. Prana means breath, life, or energy in Sanskrit. The suffix ‘itha’ means ‘gift’ or ‘receiver’. Pranitha is a name that signifies the one who is the receiver of God’s prana (life or breath).
